name: Chart
description: Represents a chart in a workbook.
remarks: The chart can be either an embedded chart (contained in a ChartObject object) or a separate chart sheet. The Charts collection contains a Chart object for each chart sheet in a workbook. Use Charts (_index_), where _index_ is the chart-sheet index number or name, to return a single Chart object. The chart _index_ number represents the position of the chart sheet on the workbook tab bar. _Charts(1)_ is the first (leftmost) chart in the workbook; _Charts(Charts.Count)_ is the last (rightmost). All chart sheets are included in the index count, even if they are hidden. The chart-sheet name is shown on the workbook tab for the chart. Use the Name property of the ChartObject object to set or return the chart name. The following example changes the color of series 1 on chart sheet 1. The following example moves the chart named Sales to the end of the active workbook. The Chart object is also a member of the Sheets collection, which contains all the sheets in the workbook (both chart sheets and worksheets). Use Sheets (_index_), where _index_ is the sheet index number or name, to return a single sheet. When a chart is the active object, you can use the ActiveChart property to refer to it.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: CodeName
properties.description: Returns the code name for the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns a Worksheet object that represents the next sheet.

properties.name: PageSetup
properties.description: Returns a PageSetup object that contains all the page setup settings for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns a Worksheet object that represents the previous sheet.

properties.name: ProtectContents
properties.description: True if the contents of the sheet are protected. For a chart, this protects the entire chart. To turn on content protection, use the Protect method with the _Contents_ argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectDrawingObjects
properties.description: True if shapes are protected. To turn on shape protection, use the Protect method with the _DrawingObjects_ argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectionMode
properties.description: True if user-interface-only protection is turned on. To turn on user interface protection, use the Protect method with the _UserInterfaceOnly_ argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlSheetVisibility value that determines whether the object is visible.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns a Shapes collection that represents all the shapes on the chart sheet. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoScaling
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel scales a 3D chart so that it's closer in size to the equivalent 2D chart. The RightAngleAxes property must be True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ChartArea
properties.description: Returns a ChartArea object that represents the complete chart area for the chart. Read-only.

properties.name: ChartTitle
properties.description: Returns a ChartTitle object that represents the title of the specified chart. Read-only.

properties.name: DataTable
properties.description: Returns a DataTable object that represents the chart data table. Read-only.

properties.name: DepthPercent
properties.description: Returns or sets the depth of a 3D chart as a percentage of the chart width (between 20 and 2000 percent). Read/write Long.

properties.name: DisplayBlanksAs
properties.description: Returns or sets the way that blank cells are plotted on a chart. Can be one of the XlDisplayBlanksAs constants. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Elevation
properties.description: Returns or sets the elevation of the 3D chart view, in degrees. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Floor
properties.description: Returns a Floor object that represents the floor of the 3D chart. Read-only.

properties.name: GapDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance between the data series in a 3D chart as a percentage of the marker width. The value of this property must be between 0 and 500. Read/write Long.

properties.name: HasAxis
properties.description: Returns or sets which axes exist on the chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: HasDataTable
properties.description: True if the chart has a data table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasLegend
properties.description: True if the chart has a legend. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasTitle
properties.description: True if the axis or chart has a visible title. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HeightPercent
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of a 3D chart as a percentage of the chart width (between 5 and 500 percent). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Hyperlinks
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlinks collection that represents the hyperlinks for the chart.

properties.name: Legend
properties.description: Returns a Legend object that represents the legend for the chart. Read-only.

properties.name: Perspective
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the perspective for the 3D chart view.

properties.name: PlotArea
properties.description: Returns a PlotArea object that represents the plot area of a chart. Read-only.

properties.name: PlotVisibleOnly
properties.description: True if only visible cells are plotted. False if both visible and hidden cells are plotted. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RightAngleAxes
properties.description: True if the chart axes are at right angles, independent of chart rotation or elevation. Applies only to 3D line, column, and bar charts. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the 3D chart view (the rotation of the plot area around the z-axis, in degrees). The value of this property must be from 0 to 360, except for 3D bar charts, where the value must be from 0 to 44. The default value is 20. Applies only to 3D charts. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ChartType
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart type. Read/write XlChartType.

properties.name: Walls
properties.description: Returns a Walls object that represents the walls of the 3D chart. Read-only.

properties.name: BarShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape used with the 3D bar or column chart. Read/write XlBarShape.

properties.name: PlotBy
properties.description: Returns or sets the way columns or rows are used as data series on the chart. Can be one of the following XlRowCol constants: xlColumns or xlRows. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ProtectFormatting
properties.description: True if chart formatting cannot be modified by the user. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectData
properties.description: True if series formulas cannot be modified by the user. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectSelection
properties.description: True if chart elements cannot be selected. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PivotLayout
properties.description: Returns a PivotLayout object that represents the placement of fields in a PivotTable report and the placement of axes in a PivotChart report. Read-only.

properties.name: Tab
properties.description: Returns a Tab object for a chart.

properties.name: MailEnvelope
properties.description: Represents an email header for a document.

properties.name: ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to show the data labels when the value is greater than the maximum value on the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SideWall
properties.description: Returns a Walls object that allows the user to individually format the side wall of a 3D chart. Read-only.

properties.name: BackWall
properties.description: Returns a Walls object that allows the user to individually format the back wall of a 3D chart. Read-only.

properties.name: ChartStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart style for the chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PrintedCommentPages
properties.description: Returns the number of comment pages that will be printed for the current chart. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowReportFilterFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display the report filter field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowLegendFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display legend field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAxisFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display axis field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowValueFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display the value field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAllFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display all field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: CategoryLabelLevel
properties.description: Returns an XlCategoryLabelLevel constant referring to the level of where the category labels are being sourced from. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: SeriesNameLevel
properties.description: Returns an XlSeriesNameLevel constant referring to the level of where the series names are being sourced from. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: ChartColor
properties.description: Returns or sets an Integer that represents the color scheme for the chart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowExpandCollapseEntireFieldButtons
properties.description: True to display the Expand Entire Field and Collapse Entire Field buttons on the specified PivotChart. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Makes the current chart the active chart.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the sheet to another location in the workbook.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: The sheet before which the copied sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _Before_ if you specify _After_.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The sheet after which the copied sheet will be placed. You cannot specify _After_ if you specify _Before_.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves the chart to another location in the workbook.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: The sheet before which the moved chart will be placed. You cannot specify _Before_ if you specify _After_.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The sheet after which the moved chart will be placed. You cannot specify _After_ if you specify _Before_.

methods.name: PrintPreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of the object as it would look when printed.

parameters.name: EnableChanges
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to specify if the user can change the margins and other page setup options available in print preview.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the object.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: Used only with sheets. True to replace the current selection with the specified object. False to extend the current selection to include any previously selected objects and the specified object.

methods.name: Unprotect
methods.description: Removes protection from a sheet or workbook. This method has no effect if the sheet or workbook isn't protected.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A string that denotes the case-sensitive password to use to unprotect the chart. If the chart isn't protected with a password, this argument is ignored.

methods.name: Axes
methods.signature: Axes([Type As Variant], [AxisGroup As XlAxisGroup]) As Object
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single axis or a collection of the axes on the chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the axis to return. Can be one of the following XlAxisType constants: xlValue, xlCategory, or xlSeriesAxis (xlSeriesAxis is valid only for 3D charts).

parameters.name: AxisGroup
parameters.description: Specifies the axis group. If this argument is omitted, the primary group is used. 3D charts have only one axis group.

methods.name: SetBackgroundPicture
methods.description: Sets the background graphic for a chart.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The name of the graphic file.

methods.name: ChartGroups
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single chart group (a ChartGroup object) or a collection of all the chart groups in the chart (a ChartGroups object). The returned collection includes every type of group.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The chart group number.

methods.name: ChartObjects
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single embedded chart (a ChartObject object) or a collection of all the embedded charts (a ChartObjects object) on the sheet.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the chart. This argument can be an array to specify more than one chart.

methods.name: ChartWizard
methods.signature: ChartWizard([Source As Variant], [Gallery As Variant], [Format As Variant], [PlotBy As Variant], [CategoryLabels As Variant], [SeriesLabels As Variant], [HasLegend As Variant], [Title As Variant], [CategoryTitle As Variant], [ValueTitle As Variant], [ExtraTitle As Variant])
methods.description: Modifies the properties of the given chart. Use this method to quickly format a chart without setting all the individual properties. This method is noninteractive, and it changes only the specified properties.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The range that contains the source data for the new chart. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel edits the active chart sheet or the selected chart on the active worksheet.

parameters.name: Gallery
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlChartType specifying the chart type.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The option number for the built-in autoformats. Can be a number from 1 through 10, depending on the gallery type. If this argument is omitted, Excel chooses a default value based on the gallery type and data source.

parameters.name: PlotBy
parameters.description: Specifies whether the data for each series is in rows or columns. Can be one of the following XlRowCol constants: xlRows or xlColumns.

parameters.name: CategoryLabels
parameters.description: An integer specifying the number of rows or columns within the source range that contain category labels. Legal values are from 0 (zero) through one less than the maximum number of the corresponding categories or series.

parameters.name: SeriesLabels
parameters.description: An integer specifying the number of rows or columns within the source range that contain series labels. Legal values are from 0 (zero) through one less than the maximum number of the corresponding categories or series.

parameters.name: HasLegend
parameters.description: True to include a legend.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The chart title text.

parameters.name: CategoryTitle
parameters.description: The category axis title text.

parameters.name: ValueTitle
parameters.description: The value axis title text.

parameters.name: ExtraTitle
parameters.description: The series axis title for 3D charts or the second value axis title for 2D charts.

methods.name: CheckSpelling
methods.signature: CheckSpelling([CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [AlwaysSuggest As Variant], [SpellLang As Variant])
methods.description: Checks the spelling of an object.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: A string that indicates the file name of the custom dictionary to be examined if the word isn't found in the main dictionary. If this argument is omitted, the currently specified dictionary is used.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel ignore words that are all uppercase. False to have Excel check words that are all uppercase. If this argument is omitted, the current setting will be used.

parameters.name: AlwaysSuggest
parameters.description: True to have Excel display a list of suggested alternate spellings when an incorrect spelling is found. False to have Excel wait for you to input the correct spelling. If this argument is omitted, the current setting will be used.

parameters.name: SpellLang
parameters.description: The language of the dictionary being used. Can be one of the MsoLanguageID values.

methods.name: CopyPicture
methods.signature: CopyPicture([Appearance As XlPictureAppearance], [Format As XlCopyPictureFormat], [Size As XlPictureAppearance])
methods.description: Copies the selected object to the Clipboard as a picture.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: Specifies how the picture should be copied. The default value is xlScreen.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The format of the picture. The default value is xlPicture.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the copied picture when the object is a chart on a chart sheet (not embedded on a worksheet). The default value is xlPrinter.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Converts a Microsoft Excel name to an object or a value.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the object, using the naming convention of Microsoft Excel.

methods.name: Location
methods.signature: Location(Where As XlChartLocation, [Name As Variant]) As Chart
methods.description: Moves the chart to a new location.

parameters.name: Where
parameters.description: Where to move the chart.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Required if _Where_ is xlLocationAsObject. The name of the sheet where the chart will be embedded if _Where_ is xlLocationAsObject, or the name of the new sheet if _Where_ is xlLocationAsNewSheet.

methods.name: OLEObjects
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single OLE object (an OLEObject) or a collection of all OLE objects (an OLEObjects collection) on the chart or sheet. Read-only.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the OLE object.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes chart data from the Clipboard into the specified chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the chart information to paste if a chart is on the Clipboard. Can be one of the following XlPasteType constants: xlPasteFormats, xlPasteFormulas, or xlPasteAll. The default value is xlPasteAll. If there's data other than a chart on the Clipboard, this argument cannot be used.

methods.name: SeriesCollection
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single series (a Series object) or a collection of all the series (a SeriesCollection collection) in the chart or chart group.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the series.

methods.name: GetChartElement
methods.signature: GetChartElement(x As Long, y As Long, ElementID As Long, Arg1 As Long, Arg2 As Long)
methods.description: Returns information about the chart element at specified _x_ and _y_ coordinates. This method is unusual in that you specify values for only the first two arguments. Microsoft Excel fills in the other arguments, and your code should examine those values when the method returns.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The _x_ coordinate of the chart element.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The _y_ coordinate of the chart element.

parameters.name: ElementID
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains the XLChartItem value of the chart element at the specified coordinates. For more information, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains information related to the chart element. For more information, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains information related to the chart element. For more information, see the Remarks section.

methods.name: SetSourceData
methods.description: Sets the source data range for the chart.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The range that contains the source data.

parameters.name: PlotBy
parameters.description: Specifies the way the data is to be plotted. Can be either of the following XlRowCol constants: xlColumns or xlRows.

methods.name: Export
methods.signature: Export(Filename As String, [FilterName As Variant], [Interactive As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Exports the chart in a graphic format.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The name of the exported file.

parameters.name: FilterName
parameters.description: The language-independent name of the graphic filter as it appears in the registry.

parameters.name: Interactive
parameters.description: True to display the dialog box that contains the filter-specific options. If this argument is False, Microsoft Excel uses the default values for the filter. The default value is False.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Causes the specified chart to be redrawn immediately.

methods.name: ApplyDataLabels
methods.signature: ApplyDataLabels([Type As XlDataLabelsType], [LegendKey As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [HasLeaderLines As Variant], [ShowSeriesName As Variant], [ShowCategoryName As Variant], [ShowValue As Variant], [ShowPercentage As Variant], [ShowBubbleSize As Variant], [Separator As Variant])
methods.description: Applies data labels to all the series in a chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of data label to apply.

parameters.name: LegendKey
parameters.description: True to show the legend key next to the point. The default value is False.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on content.

parameters.name: HasLeaderLines
parameters.description: For the Chart and Series objects, True if the series has leader lines.

parameters.name: ShowSeriesName
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the series name for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowCategoryName
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the category name for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowValue
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the value for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowPercentage
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the percentage for the data label.

parameters.name: ShowBubbleSize
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to enable or disable the bubble size for the data label.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The separator for the data label.

methods.name: Protect
methods.signature: Protect([Password As Variant], [DrawingObjects As Variant], [Contents As Variant], [Scenarios As Variant], [UserInterfaceOnly As Variant])
methods.description: Protects a chart so that it cannot be modified.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A string that specifies a case-sensitive password for the worksheet or workbook. If this argument is omitted, you can unprotect the worksheet or workbook without using a password. Otherwise, you must specify the password to unprotect the worksheet or workbook. If you forget the password, you cannot unprotect the worksheet or workbook. Use strong passwords that combine uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Weak passwords don't mix these elements. Strong password: Y6dh!et5. Weak password: House27. Passwords should be 8 or more characters in length. A pass phrase that uses 14 or more characters is better. It's critical that you remember your password. If you forget your password, Microsoft cannot retrieve it. Store the passwords that you write down in a secure place away from the information that they help protect.

parameters.name: DrawingObjects
parameters.description: True to protect shapes. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Contents
parameters.description: True to protect contents. For a chart, this protects the entire chart. For a worksheet, this protects the locked cells. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Scenarios
parameters.description: True to protect scenarios. This argument is valid only for worksheets. The default value is True.

parameters.name: UserInterfaceOnly
parameters.description: True to protect the user interface, but not macros. If this argument is omitted, protection applies both to macros and to the user interface.

methods.name: ApplyLayout
methods.description: Applies the layouts shown in the ribbon.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: Specifies the type of layout. The type of layout is denoted by a number from 1 to 10.

parameters.name: ChartType
parameters.description: The type of chart.

methods.name: SetElement
methods.description: Sets chart elements on a chart. Read/write MsoChartElementType.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Specifies the chart element type.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([From As Variant], [To As Variant], [Copies As Variant], [Preview As Variant], [ActivePrinter As Variant], [PrintToFile As Variant], [Collate As Variant], [PrToFileName As Variant])
methods.description: Prints the object.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start printing. If this argument is omitted, printing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to print. If this argument is omitted, printing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to print. If this argument is omitted, one copy is printed.

parameters.name: Preview
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel invoke print preview before printing the object. False (or omitted) to print the object immediately.

parameters.name: ActivePrinter
parameters.description: Sets the name of the active printer.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: True to print to a file. If _PrToFileName_ is not specified, Excel prompts the user to enter the name of the output file.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: True to collate multiple copies.

parameters.name: PrToFileName
parameters.description: If _PrintToFile_ is set to True, this argument specifies the name of the file that you want to print to.

methods.name: ApplyChartTemplate
methods.description: Applies a standard or custom chart type to a chart.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file name for a chart template.

methods.name: SaveChartTemplate
methods.description: Saves a custom chart template to the list of available chart templates.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The name of the chart template.

methods.name: SetDefaultChart
methods.description: Specifies the name of the chart template that Microsoft Excel uses when creating new charts.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the default chart template that will be used when creating new charts. This name can be a string naming a chart in the gallery for a user-defined template, or it can be a special constant xlBuiltIn (XlChartGallery) to specify a built-in chart template.

methods.name: ClearToMatchStyle
methods.description: Clears the chart elements formatting to automatic.

methods.name: FullSeriesCollection
methods.description: Enables retrieving the filtered out series specified by the _Index_ argument.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The indexed number of the filtered out Series object.

methods.name: ClearToMatchColorStyle
methods.description: Clears all colors on the specified chart that don't follow the color style applied to the chart.

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(Type As XlFixedFormatType, [Filename As Variant], [Quality As Variant], [IncludeDocProperties As Variant], [IgnorePrintAreas As Variant], [From As Variant], [To As Variant], [OpenAfterPublish As Variant], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant], [WorkIdentity As Variant])
methods.description: Exports to a file of the specified format.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of file format to export to.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path, or Microsoft Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Optional XlFixedFormatQuality. Specifies the quality of the published file.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProperties
parameters.description: True to include the document properties; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: IgnorePrintAreas
parameters.description: True to ignore any print areas set when publishing; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start publishing. If this argument is omitted, publishing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to publish. If this argument is omitted, publishing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: OpenAfterPublish
parameters.description: True to display the file in the viewer after it is published; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Pointer to the FixedFormatExt class.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)

methods.name: SaveAs
methods.signature: SaveAs(Filename As String, [FileFormat As Variant], [Password As Variant], [WriteResPassword As Variant], [ReadOnlyRecommended As Variant], [CreateBackup As Variant], [AddToMru As Variant], [TextCodepage As Variant], [TextVisualLayout As Variant], [Local As Variant])
methods.description: Saves changes to the chart or worksheet in a different file.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: Variant. A string that indicates the name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path; if you don't, Microsoft Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: FileFormat
parameters.description: The file format to use when you save the file. For a list of valid choices, see the FileFormat property. For an existing file, the default format is the last file format specified; for a new file, the default is the format of the version of Excel being used.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A case-sensitive string (no more than 15 characters) that indicates the protection password to be given to the file.

parameters.name: WriteResPassword
parameters.description: A string that indicates the write-reservation password for this file. If a file is saved with the password and the password isn't supplied when the file is opened, the file is opened as read-only.

parameters.name: ReadOnlyRecommended
parameters.description: True to display a message when the file is opened, recommending that the file be opened as read-only.

parameters.name: CreateBackup
parameters.description: True to create a backup file.

parameters.name: AddToMru
parameters.description: True to add this workbook to the list of recently used files. The default value is False.

parameters.name: TextCodepage
parameters.description: Not used in U.S. English Microsoft Excel.

parameters.name: TextVisualLayout
parameters.description: Not used in U.S. English Microsoft Excel.

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: True saves files against the language of Microsoft Excel (including control panel settings). False (default) saves files against the language of Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) (which is typically US English unless the VBA project where Workbooks.Open is run from is an old internationalized XL5/95 VBA project).

events.name: Activate
events.description: Occurs when a workbook, worksheet, chart sheet, or embedded chart is activated.

events.name: Deactivate
events.description: Occurs when the chart, worksheet, or workbook is deactivated.

events.name: Resize
events.description: Occurs when the chart is resized.

events.name: MouseDown
events.signature: MouseDown(Button As Long, Shift As Long, x As Long, y As Long)
events.description: Occurs when a mouse button is pressed while the pointer is over a chart.

parameters.name: Button
parameters.description: The mouse button that was released. Can be one of the following XlMouseButton constants: xlNoButton, xlPrimaryButton, or xlSecondaryButton.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and AlShift, Ctrl, and AlttShift, Ctrl, and Alt keys when the event occurred. Can be one of or a sum of values.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The _x_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The _y_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

events.name: MouseUp
events.signature: MouseUp(Button As Long, Shift As Long, x As Long, y As Long)
events.description: Occurs when a mouse button is released while the pointer is over a chart.

parameters.name: Button
parameters.description: The mouse button that was released. Can be one of the following XlMouseButton constants: xlNoButton, xlPrimaryButton, or xlSecondaryButton.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys when the event occurred. Can be one of or a sum of values.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The _x_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The _y_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

events.name: MouseMove
events.signature: MouseMove(Button As Long, Shift As Long, x As Long, y As Long)
events.description: Occurs when the position of the mouse pointer changes over a chart.

parameters.name: Button
parameters.description: The mouse button that was released. Can be one of the following XlMouseButton constants: xlNoButton, xlPrimaryButton, or xlSecondaryButton.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys when the event occurred. Can be one of or a sum of values.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The _x_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The _y_ coordinate of the mouse pointer in chart object client coordinates.

events.name: BeforeRightClick
events.description: Occurs when a chart element is right-clicked, before the default right-click action.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the default right-click action isn't performed when the procedure is finished.

events.name: BeforeDoubleClick
events.signature: BeforeDoubleClick(ElementID As Long, Arg1 As Long, Arg2 As Long, Cancel As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when a chart element is double-clicked, before the default double-click action.

parameters.name: ElementID
parameters.description: The double-clicked object. The value of this parameter determines the expected values of _Arg1_ and _Arg2_. For more information about this parameter, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: Additional event information, depending on the value of _ElementID_. For more information about this parameter, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: Additional event information, depending on the value of _ElementID_. For more information about this parameter, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: False when the event occurs. If the event procedure sets this argument to True, the default double-click action isn't performed when the procedure is finished.

events.name: Select
events.signature: Select(ElementID As Long, Arg1 As Long, Arg2 As Long)
events.description: Occurs when a chart element is selected.

parameters.name: ElementID
parameters.description: The selected chart element. For more information about this argument, see the BeforeDoubleClick event.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: The selected chart element. For more information about this argument, see the BeforeDoubleClick event.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: The selected chart element. For more information about this argument, see the BeforeDoubleClick event.

events.name: SeriesChange
events.signature: SeriesChange(SeriesIndex As Long, PointIndex As Long)
events.description: Occurs when the user changes the value of a chart data point by choosing a bar in the chart and dragging the top edge up or down thus changing the value of the data point.

parameters.name: SeriesIndex
parameters.description: The offset within the Series collection for the changed series.

parameters.name: PointIndex
parameters.description: The offset within the Points collection for the changed point.

events.name: Calculate
events.description: Occurs after the chart plots new or changed data for the Chart object.
